newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 28.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Rehabilitation and extension work at Abidjan International Airport launched by Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan; first phase to be completed in six months comrpises expansion of aircraft parking area and improved lighting; second phase to be finished by 1999 will extend departure hall and freight areas, roughly doubling airport's floor area.

- Calm returns to Ivory Coast campuses following tense 72-hour strike called by students after jailing of three militant colleagues; education minister says inquiry launched into death of male student in one Abidjan campus.
- African Development Bank and U.N. Food and Agriculture Organisation sign accord on joint programmes for rural development and food security in Africa.

- Cellular operator Telecel de Loteney, one of three in Ivory Coast, to extend mobile phone network from Abidjan to interior towns of Yamoussoukro, Bouake and Khorogo by April this year, advertisement says.
